reviews.body:
**Checked**
- #2419: the cause holds at `main` (in-place `file.patch =` on immer-frozen context files); the stage now puts recovered hunks on copies, so deterministic checks run instead of throwing.
- `filesFor` reads the reassigned `reviewedFiles`/`ignoredFiles`, so tool selection, routing and clipping all see the recovered hunks; the split by length is safe since `backfillMissingPatches` maps one-to-one.
- `run-analyzers.stage.spec.ts`: 21 pass on this branch; the new case fails with `main`'s stage.
- The failing backend job is `user.repository.integration.spec.ts` (`relation "users" does not exist` in the fork run), unrelated to this change; `eligibility` fails on the fork token.

QA passed. Tested at e67866fc merged with `main` (includes #2537, which unblocked raw-diff recovery on GitHub).

On a GitHub PR whose large file comes without `patch`, `main` crashes `RunAnalyzersStage` with `Cannot assign to read only property 'patch'`.
